text:
Alex K: quick sync — finalizing internal release note for release 0.9.1. Deploy planned 15:00 PT tomorrow. Need: final microcopy for the internal announcement, confirmation of embargo window, and ops standby + rollback lanes. Can legal/security sign off by EOD?

Maria G: I can run copy. Dropped a draft here: https://go/docs/rn/0.9.1-draft — will trim to a short blurb for internal blast.

Samir P: LGTM on draft. Heads up: we changed the prompt param behavior (breaking for some integrations). Add a short note and rollback recipe.

Jing L: Suggest a 1-line microcopy instead of long paragraph. Something like: "Improved inference stability and infra fixes; minor prompt param change — see dev docs for migration." Short + link.

Alex K: good call Jing. We need: (1) short blurb for #general, (2) expanded internal note for product owners, (3) ops checklist. Maria — can you produce both?

Maria G: yes. Will paste both below in ~30m. Also tagging @legal and @security for signoff.

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby 14:30–16:30 PT. Deploybot shows queued job 789 for the rollout. My rollback plan: pin to commit abc123 and switch model -> v1.2 fallback if need.

deploy-bot: Deploy job #789 queued by Alex K. Canary config: 10% for 20 minutes, health checks every 60s. To run now: `/deploy run 789`. To abort: `/deploy abort 789`.

Samir P: Add these regression triggers to the ops checklist:
- error_rate > 2% sustained for 5m
- p50 latency increase > 40% for 10m
If hit, rollback to pinned commit and model v1.2.

Alex K: ok writing ops checklist and rollback matrix. Maria — once you post the internal snippet, can you schedule the #general heads-up 30m prior to deploy? Recommend the short blurb + link to expanded note.

Maria G: got it. Draft microcopy for #general:
"Release 0.9.1 (tomorrow 15:00 PT): improved inference stability and infra fixes. Minor prompt param change — see https://go/docs/rn/0.9.1 for migration steps. Ops will be on standby." :loudspeaker:

Alex K: perfect. Expanded internal note below (for product owners / support):
---
Release 0.9.1 — internal rollout notes
- Deploy window: 15:00 PT
- Canary: 10% for 20m -> escalate to 100% if healthy
- Key changes: inference stability improvements, KV cache lock bugfix, prompt param semantics adjusted (see migration doc)
- Rollback criteria: error_rate > 2% for 5m OR p50 latency +40% for 10m
- Rollback actions: 1) pin service to commit abc123 2) switch model routing to v1.2 fallback 3) revert feature flag `prompt-param-v2`
- Contacts: ops-oncall, Samir P, Alex K
---

Jing L: can we also add a short note to engineering teams to verify SDK calls that use the prompt param? Ping dev-ex.

Maria G: added that line. Scheduling internal announcement to go 30m prior to deploy in the #general digest and sending expanded note to product owners and support.

ops-oncall: I'll run the preflight checks at 14:45 PT and confirm readiness in this thread. If anything looks off, i'll call a hard-hold.

Alex K: thanks — last item: deploybot command snippet for ops runbook (so support can reproduce) — please include exactly below:
```
# run canary
/deploy run 789
# abort
/deploy abort 789
# pin
/service pin --commit=abc123
# switch model
/models route --set default=v1.2
```

Maria G: pasted that into the runbook and into the internal note. Legal/security ack pending but not expecting blocking items.

Samir P: I'll watch dashboards during canary. If all green after 30m, we'll proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: Reminder: set `--canary=10% --canary-duration=20m` when running `/deploy run 789` for production.

Alex K: excellent. Closing this thread after Maria posts the final messages. Thanks everyone :rocket:

Maria G: final post scheduled for 14:30 PT tomorrow to #general, expanded note sent to product/support. I'll ping here when posted.
